abstract: For an imaginary quadratic field K = Q(sqrt(-d_K)) and a positive-definite K-Hermitian space (V, h_V), we prove an all-genus K-linear Seifert-Bruhat determinant formula for the parabolic form H_par of any generating tuple in U_d(K, h_V) with V^Pi = 0 and even dimension 2m, expressing (-1)^m det_K(H_par) modulo N_{K/Q}(K^*) as the product of local Wall invariants Theta(C_j). For finite-order elements with det_K(g) in {+1, -1}, we prove the Hodge-balance character law (-1)^k Theta(g) = (-sqrt(-d_K))^delta q(g) with positive rational q(g) and reflection-length parity l_R(g) - k(g) = delta(g) mod 2, whose complex phases cancel on balanced families in all genera. We establish an exact monomial-cycle formula for G(4, p, d) over Q(i), evaluate q(C) across G_24, G_29, G_31, and crystallographic Weyl groups, and prove long-reflection parity character cancellation on W(G_2), showing that G_31 is the unique irreducible order-2 reflection group in the Q(i)-Shephard-Todd list admitting non-split balanced families. In G_31, three regular classes with reflection-length excess (two of order 12 with l_R = 5 and one self-inverse class of order 6 with l_R = 6) have q(C) = 3 outside N_{Q(i)/Q}(Q(i)^*) and avoid all proper reflection subgroups. The 11-branch family has volume 45,147,375/16 > 0, generically immersing an 8-dimensional image Z_8 in the 9-dimensional non-split Q(i)-Weil sixfold domain while codimension bounds preclude dimension 9. Since every proper Hermitian subdomain of SU(3, 3) has dimension at most 6 < 8, a very general fibre of Z_8 is simple with Hodge group SU(3, 3), satisfying the rational Hodge conjecture on all powers. Finally, exact Mobius volumes in G_29 and G_24 give alternative Hurwitz-Brauer proofs for split sixfolds and fourfolds over Q(i) and Q(sqrt(-7)).
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: v2 incorporates all four referee corrections from v1 plus the two referee critiques on xtv_hHIl0y-6jH4q for Theorems 2.4 and 2.5: (1) Corrects the reflection lengths of the three non-norm classes of G_31 to l_R(C_24) = 5, l_R(C_33) = 5, and l_R(C_34) = 6 throughout the abstract, manuscript, and supplement, adds the Reflection-Length Excess Parity Law l_R(g) - k(g) == delta(g) (mod 2) (Theorem 2.2(4)), and adds exact BFS reflection-length certificates to both supplement scripts. (2) Fixes m_+ - m_- = sum_j delta(C_j) in Theorem 2.2(3), G(4,4,4) (order 1536, 24 reflections) in Theorem 4.1(1), and the non-real primitive qualification in Theorem 3.1(2). (3) Cites [17, Section 5] explicitly for canonical-extension identification after semistable alteration, uses generically immersive phrasing for the 8-dimensional image Z_8, separates new results from alternative Hurwitz-Brauer proofs of Markman [3, 4] and Koike [20] (cyclic etale degree-4 covers of genus-4 curves), and explains the CM-threefold contraction via [11, Proposition 5] in Theorem 4.2(3). (4) In Theorem 2.4(2), explicitly analyzes W(G_2) ~= G(6,6,2) = D_6 (order 12) on H = [[2,-1],[-1,2]], showing that while the 6 elements with odd long-reflection parity have individual local invariant q(g) = 3, (-1)^v_3(q(g)) == chi_long(g) is a global linear character W(G_2) -> {+1, -1} (certified across all 12 elements in Test 5), forcing prod_j q(C_j) in N_{Q(i)/Q}(Q(i)^*) on every surface-group tuple in all genera. (5) In Theorem 2.5(1), proves the reducible subdomain bound dim_C D_M <= 6 < 8 directly over C on V_C = V_Q x_K C = C^6 (proving that any proper M_C-invariant subspace U subsetneq V_C is h_t(U(1))-invariant and hence strictly H_C-nondegenerate of signature (p_1, q_1), covering both K-reducible representations and K-irreducible representations with larger endomorphism algebras End_M(V_Q) supsetneq K as in [17, Section 8.3]), and accurately describes the scope of Test 5.
title: All-Genus K-Linear Seifert-Bruhat Determinant Law, the Foster-Greenwood Dichotomy Between G_24, G_29 and G_31, and Hurwitz-Hodge Dominance for Q(i)- and Q(sqrt(-7))-Weil Sixfolds
